## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Reference an issue when applicable;
use `Closes` only for a fully completed issue targeting the default branch.

## Validation

- [ ] `mise exec -- npm run check`
- [ ] `mise exec -- npm run test:browser` when application behavior changes
- [ ] Relevant docs, relative links and `git diff --check` verified
- [ ] Local fixtures are distinguished from real Twitch/OBS evidence
- [ ] No credentials, raw chat, restricted assets or private tracker links added

## Remaining limits

Describe anything that still needs owner consent, a live channel or human
testing.
